intro: Tanaris is a vast, sweltering desert spanning the southern reaches of Kalimdor, defined by rolling sand dunes and blistering heat. At its heart lies Gadgetzan, a neutral trading outpost operated by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel. Beyond the bustling settlements, the dunes conceal hostile sand trolls, dangerous silithid hives, and the hidden domain of the bronze dragonflight.

p: Tanaris is a barren, sun-scorched wilderness. Within the walled city of Zul'Farrak, the hardened Sandfury trolls guard their isolated domain. Today, the desert floor is ruled by hyenas, basilisks, and scorpids, while subterranean tunnels snake beneath the baking earth.

Because Tanaris is as close to their island homeland of Kezan as the mainland allows, the Steamwheedle Cartel has established a thriving enterprise here. From the walled oasis of Gadgetzan to the coastal docks of Steamwheedle Port, the goblins maintain strict neutrality, welcoming coin from both the Alliance and the Horde. Their peace is maintained by heavy bruiser muscle, though rogue threats like the Southsea Freebooters constantly harass shipping and dig sites along the coastline.

The sands hide powers far older than mortal empires. In the eastern reaches lie the Caverns of Time, the ancestral domain of Nozdormu and his bronze dragonflight, whose drakes can occasionally be seen riding the desert thermals. To the south, massive stone gates mark the titan complex of Uldum. Yet a darker danger stirs from subterranean nests like the Gaping Chasm and the Noxious Lair, where creeping silithid swarms have begun burrowing outward across the sands.
